PROJECT 1VR / AI / RESEARCH

AI-Driven
VR Museum.

A virtual Bianzhong exhibition where visitors talk to an embodied AI guide and play ancient Chinese chime bells.

Unreal Engine 5ConvaiVR

CORE DEVELOPER

Scene & interaction

Built the UE5 Bianzhong exhibition and worked on lighting and rendering performance. Striking a bell with the virtual mallet triggers a prerecorded chime through collision detection.

Speech & digital human

Integrated Convai with the UE5 virtual guide to support spoken dialogue and two verbal styles: extraverted and introverted.

Study data & publication

Contributed to organizing the study data and writing the paper comparing extraverted and introverted verbal styles in AI guides.

IEEE VRW 2026 / FOURTH AUTHOR

Does AI’s
Personality Matter?

A between-subjects study with 30 participants comparing two verbal styles during museum learning and bell-playing tasks. Each participant experienced one guide condition.

Read the publication

Study results & limitations

Reported means: extraverted / introverted (Tables 3–4).

MeasureMeansp
Factual recall (out of 7)4.73 / 3.93.039
Workload (adapted NASA-TLX)24.63 / 29.28.030
Duration (seconds)682.07 / 646.27.037
Co-presence (1–7)5.53 / 4.27.007
Psychological involvement (1–7)5.57 / 4.70.018

NASA-TLX here averages four subscales (mental demand, temporal demand, performance and frustration) on a 0–100 scale. Co-presence and psychological involvement use 1–7 scales.

In this sample, emotional valence was higher in the extraverted condition (p < .001). Utterance count, behavioral engagement, arousal and dominance did not differ significantly. The small, homogeneous sample and the focus on verbal style limit generalization. Adaptive guidance was proposed as future work, not implemented in this project.
